scope: Six assigned preprocessing/QC tool families. Released notes plus post-tag primary-branch history where no newer release was listed. Source audit, not a new runtime reproduction campaign.
interpretation: A fix after the selected tool version may predate PR448's merge. Upstream fixes are not automatically pipeline findings. The frozen proposed patch and cloud runs were not changed.

tools.name: ataqv

changes.summary: The TSS-enrichment correction for --ignore-read-groups is already in pinned 1.3.1.
Later source labels 1.4.0/1.5.0 add tabular output and reduce single-nucleus memory; the final commit corrects reported version text.

tools.assessment: No later bulk-ATAC metric correctness fix identified in the five post-tag commits examined. Source version bumps are not a published/tagged release.
limitations: No new metric reproduction or exhaustive issue audit.

tools.name: khmer

actual_usage.command: unique-kmers.py -k read_length -R report fasta; only when macs_gsize is absent

checks.tag_lookup_method: git ls-remote --tags, because the connector excludes the tags endpoint

tools.assessment: No newer primary-branch fix after the actual alpha pin: v3.0.0a3 equals current master. The GitHub Releases page's v2.1.2 is older and must not be mistaken for a later replacement.
limitations: Alpha-version maintenance and accuracy are not established by the absence of later commits; no effective-genome-size reproduction.

tools.name: Subread / featureCounts

actual_usage.command: featureCounts -F SAF -O --fracOverlap 0.2; module supplies -p from meta.single_end

changes.summary: The released overlap-fraction correction is relevant to this pipeline's explicit --fracOverlap 0.2.
changes.next_check: Compare 2.0.1 against a newer tool using a tiny BAM/SAF boundary-overlap case; not reproduced here.

changes.summary: After 2.0.1, -p identifies paired input; --countReadPairs is additionally required for fragment counts.
Annotation loading for very long chromosomes was corrected; applicability needs a triggering reference.
Later junction-counting, long-read and fraction/largest-overlap changes target flags absent from these SAF calls.

tools.assessment: Existing debt, not a demonstrated PR448 regression: the tool pin was already 2.0.1. An upgrade must preserve fragment semantics and handle the known mixed SE/PE cohort issue.
limitations: Official SourceForge release history is newer than GitHub's release index. No new overlap-count reproduction; latest 30 master commit subjects were mostly aligner/fusion work and are not a full post-release featureCounts audit.

tools.name: Trim Galore

actual_usage.command: --fastqc, --gzip, one sample per task; distinct staged mate names. Proposed default adds --no_poly_g.

changes.summary: Wrong-end R2 poly-C clipping is corrected by upstream #322. The proposed default also disables the new autodetection to preserve baseline sequences.
Dev corrects a Read-2-only adapter override when no Read-1 override is supplied; current pipeline arguments supply neither.

Dev also hardens output collisions, compression detection, specialty-mode flags and poly-A/G ordering. Current one-sample tasks, distinct .fastq.gz mates and disabled poly-G avoid the identified trigger paths.

tools.assessment: The known clipping regression is already covered by the frozen proposed fix and its independent 100-pair real-module comparison. No additional default-path issue established by this notes scan.
limitations: Dev is unreleased and differs from master by 102 commits. Its changelog and recent commit subjects were reviewed, not every patch or optional argument. No further upgrade was made.

tools.name: UMI-tools

actual_usage.command: Only umi_tools extract is imported; ATACSEQ hardcodes with_umi=false, so the module is not called.

changes.summary: Post-tag #707 corrects loss of chimeric mates in the alignment writer, outside this disabled extract path.
Post-tag CRAM handling, large-bundle clustering and packaging fixes were found; this workflow uses neither UMI-tools dedup/group nor enabled extraction.

tools.assessment: Latest published release remains 1.1.6. Later merged fixes do not affect the current ATACSEQ invocation; enabling UMI processing would require a separate review.
limitations: Shared helpers and packaging changed after the tag; no claim that the whole UMI-tools release is bug-free.

tools.name: MultiQC

actual_usage.command: The reachable modules/local/multiqc.nf executes multiqc 1.13. assets/multiqc_config.yml repeats FastQC, SAMtools, Picard and featureCounts sections.

checks.released_notes_checked: v1.14 through v1.35 (29 release entries after v1.13)

changes.summary: Repeated Picard sections had a file-discovery bug; this pipeline configures Picard multiple times.
Picard MarkDuplicates parsing was hardened for mixed field types and trailing delimiters.
FastQC average-read-length calculation was corrected; variable trimmed lengths make it worth checking.
Later releases fix duplicate FastQC view behavior, R2-null Cutadapt values and featureCounts section metadata; they do not automatically imply wrong count matrices.

tools.assessment: Prioritize a separate controlled report-compatibility upgrade. PR448 did not upgrade the executing MultiQC binary; installing nf-core 1.35 did not deliver its fixes.
limitations: These are known upstream reporting fixes with plausible config overlap, not newly reproduced report defects here. An upgrade is broader than the frozen two-fix patch; no changes were made.

overall_assessment: One already reproduced Trim Galore regression is addressed by the existing proposed patch. Subread overlap precision and legacy MultiQC report parsing deserve focused follow-up tests. No new pipeline finding is asserted from release notes alone.
scope_limits: No exhaustive security, all-issue, or full optional-mode audit.
No Docker images, source branches, proposed patch, cloud jobs or pipeline files were changed during this upstream source scan.
Six assigned tool families only; complementary agent reports cover other module families.
